bullets.text: M5 MacBook Pro Lacks Adapter - **Apple** omits power adapters in the UK and EU for environmental compliance.
Waymo's London Launch - **Waymo** plans to introduce fully autonomous ride-hailing in London by 2026.
Spotify's SongDNA Feature - **Spotify** is developing a feature to showcase music credits and contributors.
Google's Recovery Contacts - **Google** introduces a feature allowing friends to help recover compromised accounts.
Apple's New Studio Display - Rumors suggest **Apple** may launch a Studio Display with a 120Hz refresh rate.
Kuku's Funding Success - Indian platform **Kuku** raises $85M to expand its audio and video content offerings.
Apple's Renewable Energy Push - **Apple** signs contracts for 650 megawatts of renewable energy in Europe.
Nscale's AI Deal with Microsoft - **Nscale** partners with **Microsoft** to deploy Nvidia GPUs across multiple data centers.
Threads Introduces Group Chats - **Meta's** Threads app adds group messaging for up to 50 users.
Apple's M5 Chip Launch - **Apple** unveils new devices powered by the M5 chip, enhancing performance significantly.
